state_model: per-layer causal key/value state for the Hermon-owned paged Llama path
context_memory: paged KV state grows with retained token positions on the described Transformer path
training_semantics: not applicable: Hermon Engine is an inference system, not the training definition
inference_semantics: default llama.cpp continuous batching plus an opt-in Hermon-owned paged-KV Llama path
checkpoint_format: GGUF for the inspected model path
reference_implementation: hermon-paged-kv CPU attention and block-pool oracle
limitations: This descriptor covers the documented paged Llama path, not every model supported by vendored llama.cpp.
